name: Mai Argiano
source:
[url=/c4040]Juni[/url]’s twin sister and first violin of the rival quartet. Cheerful and energetic, she is a protégée of unequalled potential, widely considered the greatest student the Institute has ever produced. Deeply loyal to her sister; more so than most believe.

[From an [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064244/www.elizar.com/?p=23]old review[/url] by Nargrakhan]
